policy.public_route_rule: Public routes must be anonymous-safe and must not expose private parent, student, provider, member, or Operations data.
policy.private_route_rule: Private routes must reject logged-out and wrong-scope access.

routes.security_expectation: Public read-only timer config only; no interest lead, checkout, email send, access grant, private member data, or external write is performed.
Requires a valid One Time member session token; returns ticket numbers and project-visible staff replies only, with no source context or internal notes.
Requires ticket source_context member_id and relationship_scope match; hides source context and internal/operator-only comments.
Stores private questions for staff review only; no forum post, member feed, external send, source context, or internal review notes are returned.
Readiness only: no Zoom token, client secret, host start URL, meeting creation, registrant write, webhook acceptance, recording read, transcript read, summary read, or attendance write is performed.
Preview only: no Zoom meeting is created and no host start URL is returned.
Preview only: no Zoom meeting, registrant, join redirect, webhook, attendance write, notification send, or portal publish is performed.
Preview only: no live webhook is accepted and no attendance row is mutated.
Preview only: correction drafts require operator review and do not mutate attendance rows.
Preview only: no provider webhook, recording fetch, upload, publish, unpublish, delete, member visibility, watch-progress write, or notification send is performed.
Preview only: publication, unpublishing, deletion, member visibility, and provider writes stay disabled until explicit operator approval.
Preview only: source recording deletion remains disabled until retention, backup, playback smoke, and operator approval are recorded.
Requires One Time admin scope; returns only synthetic example.test identities, cleanup manifest, scenario coverage, and no-write safety checks.
Requires One Time admin scope; returns evidence references, stage coverage, no-write flags, and explicit remaining external blockers only.

Readiness only: no raw transcript body is returned, no vector/public-helper corpus is mutated, guessed speaker identity cannot become student data, and cross-student/private retrieval remains blocked.
Readiness only: no badge award, reversal, external notification, access grant, prize/credit, or public individual leaderboard is enabled.

Requires admin scope, a Rabbi-awarded badge slug, student scope, source evidence, and a human reason; writes only a local badge plus audit event, with no external notification, access grant, prize/credit, or public individual leaderboard.
Requires admin scope and reversal reason; writes only a badge status reversal plus audit event, with no external notification, access grant, prize/credit, or public individual leaderboard.
Readiness only: no public/member post publication, external notification, unrestricted student messaging, deletion without history, or raw private question exposure is enabled.

Readiness only: no unrestricted AI chat, Sefaria/API ingestion, arbitrary translation merge, source corpus mutation, raw source text, raw transcript retrieval, cross-student retrieval, or assistant answer generation is enabled.
No production writes, no external integration writes, no raw transcript persisted, and all derived records scoped to one_time_mishnah_class/rabbi_sheller_provider.
Readiness only: no Vimeo upload, Zoom mutation, Resend send, DNS write, deploy, secret copy, or production database write is performed.
Readiness only: no assistant rows, external sends, publish actions, charges, DNS changes, OAuth actions, connector calls, secret values, or row payloads are returned or mutated.
Readiness only: no checkout creation, live card charge, payment link, invoice, invoice credit, email/WhatsApp send, external CRM write, or access grant automation is enabled.
Readiness only: no live charge, checkout session, payment link, subscription, automated access grant, receipt/welcome send, external CRM write, raw member Zoom URL, or Zoom host/start URL is enabled.
Requires platform-super-admin/all-scope identity, signs a short-lived read-only token, scopes target to TEST-ONETIME-PROVIDER-RABBI, and performs no external write.
Requires platform-super-admin/all-scope identity plus valid signed token; returns scoped read-only provider portal view and no write-capable secrets or join URLs.
Requires platform-super-admin/all-scope identity plus valid signed token; only ends the local preview session and performs no provider/member data mutation.

routes.security_expectation: Uses appendStudioScope plus requireAdmin; returns no raw private source bodies and performs no external writes.
GET is workspace/project scoped; POST resolves the target first-party BNA project and workspace before creating a Studio project.
Detail reads use assertProjectAccess and assertWorkspaceAccess before returning sources, scenes, jobs, assets, exports, and usage.
Stores raw source privately, returns only preview/normalized metadata to the UI, and does not send or publish source content.
Uses deterministic mock generation and local usage rows only; no vendor call or external write.
Writes first-party storyboard rows and scene versions only after scoped project access checks.
Compiled prompts include policy layers, delimited untrusted source context, no-send output contract, and local usage only.
Preview returns a local reversible patch only and performs no mutation or external write.
Broad/project-level corrections require explicit confirmation and remain local revision-patch rows.
Scene owner project/workspace is loaded before update; cross-workspace scene edits are rejected.
Creates deterministic mock job only after scoped scene ownership checks.
Mock render creates first-party job/assets/usage only and reports external_write_performed=false.
Job owner project/workspace is checked before retry.
Job owner project/workspace is checked before cancellation.
Usage events and budget rows are filtered through appendStudioScope before return.
Creates local Content job/output rows only; no publish, Buffer, email, access grant, upload, payment, or external CRM write.
